title: Multi-Channel Notification Pipeline Decoupling Domain Events from Deliveries
summary: Preserve NotificationEvent as immutable domain events, introduce NotificationDelivery queue table with unique([eventId, channel]) for idempotency, process delivery in autonomous background worker.
details: NotificationEvent represents a domain occurrence (PRICE_DROP, ALERT_MATCHED, etc.). Direct synchronous dispatch in web requests causes latency, timeouts, and loss of delivery status. Channel-specific delivery requires decoupled delivery queue.
